text: E. R. Frank's Life is Funny was pulled from the shelves of two Merced, Calif. middle-school libraries in 2005 because of an “X-rated” passage describing two teens' first experience with sexual intercourse. Later, parent Jim Morris challenged the book at Northern Guilford High School over sexual content. The school's media and technology advisory committee voted to retain it, and the Guilford County Board of Education then voted 5 to 1 to retain it in the school library.
meta_description: Life is Funny by E. R. Frank: pulled from two Merced middle-school libraries in 2005; retained at Northern Guilford High School by a 5 to 1 board vote.
